name: Via Outer Ring Road & Tin Factory Flyover
corridor: ORR -> Ramamurthy Nagar -> Tin Factory -> KR Puram
summary: Primary high-capacity arterial route directly via Outer Ring Road flyovers.
steps: Head east from Hebbal Flyover onto Outer Ring Road (ORR).
Pass Manyata Tech Park on the left and continue straight past Veerannapalya.
Take the Ramamurthy Nagar underpass towards Kasavanahalli / Tin Factory.
Ascend the Tin Factory Flyover merging towards KR Puram Railway Station.

name: Via Hennur Main Road & Kalyan Nagar / Ramamurthy Nagar
corridor: Hebbal -> Hennur -> Kalyan Nagar -> Ramamurthy Nagar -> KR Puram
summary: Secondary corridor avoiding ORR main carriageway by cutting through Kalyan Nagar 80ft road.
steps: Exit Hebbal towards Hennur Cross along outer service loop.
Turn right onto Hennur Main Road heading south towards Kalyan Nagar.
Take left at HRBR Layout 80 Feet Road through Kalyan Nagar commercial district.
Merge onto Ramamurthy Nagar main road connecting to Old Madras Road.
Cross under KR Puram cable bridge to reach KR Puram Junction.

name: Via Thanisandra & Old Madras Road Peripheral Bypass
corridor: Hebbal -> Thanisandra -> Narayanapura -> Old Madras Road -> KR Puram
summary: Peripheral ring detour offering wider roads and minimal signals during peak evening rush.
steps: Take northern exit from Hebbal towards Thanisandra Main Road.
Continue straight past Bhartiya City intersection towards Peripheral Road.
Turn right at Narayanapura connecting road towards Hoodi / KR Puram back-gate.
Merge onto Old Madras Road westbound at ITI Colony signal.
Arrive at KR Puram from the eastern bypass approach.
